rootCause: src/domain/order.ts renamed the `Order` field `total` to `grandTotal` (now correct and consistent at the declaration). Thirty read sites across five layers still read `order.total` — src/services (order-service, pricing, refund, tax), src/api (order-controller, serializers, validators), src/reporting (summary, csv, ledger, metrics), src/jobs (settlement, reminder, reconcile) and src/ui (order-row, receipt, badge) — each emitting TS2339: Property 'total' does not exist on type 'Order'.
expectedFix: One decision at the declaration settles all thirty diagnostics at once: revert the field name back to `total` in src/domain/order.ts. The wide alternative — keeping `grandTotal` and patching `order.total` at each of the thirty read sites — also compiles, and is listed in `consumerFiles`: it is thirty edits to consumers when the single cause lives in one declaration, and the harness scores it in its own column rather than as a false start. A false start here is a write to one of the five files no fix involves (src/domain/customer.ts, index.ts, money.ts, order-line.ts, order-status.ts).
purpose: Frozen anonymized corpus entry (T3): a deep single-cause TS2339 cascade across N files, committed so it never moves and needs no private repo. The fix is one declaration; patching each read site is the tempting wide route this entry exists to measure — scored as `consumerFiles`, not as a false start, since this entry's own expectedFix admits it compiles. Repaired 2026-08-04: B1 scored that route as a false start, which contradicted the ground truth stated here.
